newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM launches aluminium futures trading.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM launches aluminium futures trading.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) launched trading in its yen-based aluminium futures contract on Monday.
The morning session runs from 9 a.m. (0000 GMT) until 11 a.m. (0200 GMT) and the afternoon session runs from 1 p.m. (0400 GMT) until 3.30 p.m. (0630 GMT).
The aluminium contract is the first base metal futures contract ever traded in Japan.
TOCOM's benchmark February aluminium futures contract was quoted at 207.90 yen per kilogram as of 0050 GMT, after starting at 209.40 yen.
Volume in the February contract was 6,898 lots.
